name: Motorcycle Simulator United Kingdom
summary:
Ride London from the seat - on the left, the way it should be.

45 KM ROUND WEST LONDON
West on the M4 past Heston and Heathrow with the jets low over the motorway, north on four lanes of the M25, east on the M40 and Western Avenue past Northolt, Greenford and the Art Deco Hoover Building, the Wembley arch on the skyline, then the North Circular through Hanger Lane and Gunnersbury to the Chiswick roundabout and back onto the M4.
